tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards and the sidebar. Flutter: ColorScheme.surface.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, the sidebar and sheets. Cards stand out from canvas by this fill alone: no border, no shadow. Flutter: surfaceContainer.

tokens.name: card-raised
tokens.usage: A hovered list row or an inset block inside a card. Flutter: surfaceContainerHighest (night) / surfaceContainerLow (day).

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Floating elements only, over a blur of blur-glass: the phone nav pill, the info card over a map, sheets. Never on cards in the page flow.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers inside a card and chart gridlines. Never a card border. Flutter: outlineVariant.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: The empty part of a gauge or progress bar, and the ground of the segmented control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and big numbers on canvas, card and card-raised. Flutter: onSurface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, units, captions and chart axis labels on canvas and card (at least 5.4:1 in both themes). Flutter: onSurfaceVariant.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Volt, the brand colour, as a FILL: the primary button, the selected nav indicator dot, the current bar at night. Text on it is always on-accent. Never text on a light ground. Flutter: primary (night).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent. Flutter: onPrimary.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: The accent as TEXT or a MARK: links, the gauge arc, the current bar, the route line. By day it darkens to olive so it reads on white (6.7:1). Flutter: primary (day).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: The ground of a selected nav item, segment or chip. Flutter: primaryContainer.

tokens.name: on-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-soft. Flutter: onPrimaryContainer.

tokens.name: bar-muted
tokens.usage: Past periods in a bar chart, beside the current one in accent-strong. Holds 3:1 on card in both themes.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Tail light. The finish marker on a map and a state that asks for care (readiness: go easy). Not an error. Flutter: tertiary.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a state chip that carries signal text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: A part close to its wear limit, a reminder due soon. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive menu entries. Always with a word or icon. Flutter: error.

tokens.name: map-ground
tokens.usage: Map tiles are dimmed and desaturated toward this colour so the route is the brightest thing on the map.

tokens.name: map-road
tokens.usage: Roads on the dimmed map, in previews.

tokens.name: route-glow
tokens.usage: The blurred stroke drawn under the route line.

tokens.name: series-elevation
tokens.usage: Elevation profile in ride charts.

tokens.name: series-speed
tokens.usage: Speed in ride charts.

tokens.name: series-power
tokens.usage: Power in ride charts; fatigue in the form chart.

tokens.name: series-heartrate
tokens.usage: Heart rate in ride charts.

tokens.name: series-cadence
tokens.usage: Cadence in ride charts; form in the form chart.

tokens.name: series-wprime
tokens.usage: W′ balance in ride charts.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The large page title in PageScaffold, once per screen. Flutter: headlineLarge.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The wordmark at the top of the expanded rail.

styles.name: kpi
styles.usage: The one big number of a stat card. Regular weight: size makes it stand out, not boldness. Tabular figures.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: A secondary number: a gauge's centre, a value in a list row.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: A card's title, sentence case. No uppercase eyebrows. Flutter: titleMedium.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Keep it easy: endurance pace, no hard efforts.
styles.usage: Running text and a card's one explaining sentence. Flutter: bodyLarge.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Details under a number, links, chip labels. Flutter: bodySmall.

styles.name: axis
styles.usage: Chart axis labels and values on bars, in ink-muted (values on the current bar in ink). Flutter: labelSmall.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Icon to its label; number to its unit.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Inside a card, between title, number and sentence.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Between rows of a list inside a card.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: The gap between cards, and the page gutter on a phone.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Card padding, and the gutter from 600 dp.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: The gutter from 1200 dp; space above a page section.

tokens.name: space-xxxl
tokens.usage: Space above the first card under a large title.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Bar tops in charts, small inset blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Nav items, list rows, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: A card that floats over the page, such as the info card on a map.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, segmented controls, the nav pill.

shadow.note: Cards in the page have no shadow. Only floating glass elements cast one.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The nav pill, the info card over a map, sheets.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Blur radius behind glass. On devices that cannot afford it, glass becomes 96 % opaque instead.
